text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text: Ship the live HTML/CSS prototype tonight using mocked API responses. This keeps the team focused on the interface’s visibility and liveliness without waiting for backend delays. The trade-off is temporary fake data, but it lets us test the visual flow and user experience immediately.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Mocked responses hide the real cost of network variability—latency spikes, partial failures, and race conditions will surface only when the real API connects. Instead, ship a *thin* live API stub that mimics real behavior but remains under our control; this tests the interface’s robustness without pretending the backend is stable. Settle it by running a 10-minute chaos test: inject 500ms delays and 10% failure rates to see if the UI degrades gracefully.
